case: Engalla v. Permanente Medical Group, Inc.
dissent: Justice Janice Rogers Brown, joined by Justice Joyce Kennard (dissenting on FAA preemption/waiver; not contesting fraud analysis)
status: Binding California Supreme Court authority. Still controlling as of 2026-04-10 on the fraudulent inducement of contracts issue.
post_engalla_developments: Later federal preemption cases (Southland Corp., AT&T Mobility v. Concepcion 2011) address the arbitration-specific aspects. The § 1572 fraud analysis is unaffected by those developments.
